inputs.text: This looks less like a political transition and more like a coordinated takeover: squeeze local people until they can no longer hold on to their property or businesses, then let wealthy diaspora and foreign investors buy up what’s left cheaply. The key question is who is steering it and setting up the conditions for them to profit. I don’t buy that residents losing out is some accidental side effect.

output.main_topic: Alleged deliberate economic displacement enabling investors to acquire local property and businesses
subtopics: Local people losing property or businesses
Wealthy diaspora and foreign investors buying what remains
Suspicion of deliberate steering and profit-making
